dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です。今日はどのようなお悩みでこちらにいらっしゃいましたか？
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm a counselor here. What brings you in today?

dialogue.content: こんばんわ　きょうは家族の事で相談したいです
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'd like to talk about a family matter today.

dialogue.content: ご家族のことですね。かしこまりました。
dialogue.English: A family matter, I see. Understood.

dialogue.content: ご家族のことで，どのようなお悩みをお持ちでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What kind of concerns do you have regarding your family?

dialogue.content: ２才上の姉がいます　彼女は今妻子ある人と不倫をしているようで
dialogue.English: I have a sister who is two years older than me. It seems she's having an affair with a married man.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 私の相談をしてきたのですが
dialogue.English: She came to me for advice...

dialogue.content: 私にです
dialogue.English: To me, that is.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 私はどう答えていいかわかりません
dialogue.English: And I don't know how to respond to her.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。不倫となると答えを探すのは難しいですよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. When it comes to an affair, it can be very difficult to know what to say.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 姉は一度結婚をしましたがすぐに離婚して
dialogue.English: My sister married once but divorced soon after,

dialogue.content: ええ，
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm,

dialogue.content: また別の男性と結婚まで話がいっていたのですが　途中で止めました
dialogue.English: Then, she was about to get married to another man, but she called it off.

dialogue.content: 昔から友達も多くて、結構楽しい人生を送っていたのですが
dialogue.English: She's always had a lot of friends and seemed to live a pretty happy life, but...

dialogue.content: 最近はその男性とのことで悩んで鬱っぽくなってます
dialogue.English: Lately she's been troubled over this man and seems depressed.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね…。お姉さまは結婚関係では今まであまりうまくいっていないのですね。それはお姉さんのことが心配になりますよね。
dialogue.English: I see... So, your sister hasn't had much luck with relationships leading to marriage. It's natural that you would be worried about her.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今回のお姉さまからの相談はどのような内容だったのでしょうか？もう少し詳しく聞かせていただけますか？
dialogue.English: What was the nature of the advice your sister was asking for this time? Could you tell me a little more about it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 彼は最初独身だと嘘をついていたらしく　姉は本気で好きになっていったようです
dialogue.English: Apparently, he lied at first and said he was single, so my sister fell seriously in love with him.

dialogue.content: 途中から彼の様子がおかしいので　住所などを調べていったら家庭があったのです
dialogue.English: She started to feel something was off about him, so she looked up his address and found out he had a family.

dialogue.content: ええ！嘘をつかれていたのですか…
dialogue.English: Oh! So she was lied to...

dialogue.content: それが始まりだったのですが
dialogue.English: That's how it started, but

dialogue.content: ええ，
dialogue.English: I see,

dialogue.content: はい　嘘だったようです
dialogue.English: Yes, it seems it was a lie.

dialogue.content: その時に別れていたらよかったのに
dialogue.English: If only she had broken up with him then.

dialogue.content: 友人にも紹介していたし　今さら引けない状態だったみたいで
dialogue.English: But she had already introduced him to her friends, and it seems she felt she was in too deep to back out.

dialogue.content: 調べた事も言えなかったようです
dialogue.English: It seems she couldn't even tell him that she had looked him up.

dialogue.content: まだその頃は私には相談をされていなかったのですが
dialogue.English: She hadn't come to me for advice back then.

dialogue.content: お姉さまは周囲のお友達にも紹介するほど本気だったのですね，
dialogue.English: So your sister was serious enough to introduce him to her friends,

dialogue.content: ええ，
dialogue.English: I see,

dialogue.content: だったと思います　彼女はのめり込むタイプで
dialogue.English: I think so. She's the type to get really invested.

dialogue.content: 別れることに納得いかない状態です
dialogue.English: She just can't accept breaking up with him.

dialogue.content: 私はもう別れたらと説得しているのですが
dialogue.English: I've been trying to convince her to just break up with him, but...

dialogue.content: なるほど，お姉さまは，好きになった人が妻子持ちだったが，とても好きなので別れたくないと思っていらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.English: I see. So your sister found out the man she fell in love with has a wife and children, but she loves him so much that she doesn't want to break up.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 私の言うことなど聞く耳はもっていないです
dialogue.English: She won't listen to anything I say.

dialogue.content: 説得がお姉さまに届かないのですね
dialogue.English: Your attempts to persuade her aren't getting through.

dialogue.content: 今は私にだけ相談してきていてるみたいで
dialogue.English: It seems I'm the only one she's talking to about this now.

dialogue.content: 私は結婚もしていないから　全くわからなくて
dialogue.English: I've never been married, so I don't understand it at all.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 不倫する意味もわかりません
dialogue.English: I don't even understand why people have affairs.

dialogue.content: そうですよね，なかなか理解が難しいですよね
dialogue.English: Right, it's something that's very difficult to understand.

dialogue.content: 相談員さんはどうおもいますか？
dialogue.English: What do you think, counselor?

dialogue.content: そうですね，難しい問題だと思いますので，いったん整理させていただきますね
dialogue.English: Well, it is a difficult issue, so let me just summarize the situation to make sure I understand.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 相談者様はお姉さまの不倫の相談を受けてこちらにいらっしゃいましたね。
dialogue.English: You've come here today because your sister has confided in you about her affair, is that right?

dialogue.content: お願いします
dialogue.English: Please do.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お姉さまは今までも結婚関係には苦労されてきていて，今回は独身と思って本気で好きになった方が妻子持ちだったことが分かり，
dialogue.English: Your sister has had difficulties with relationships in the past, and this time, the man she fell seriously in love with, believing he was single, turned out to have a wife and children.

dialogue.content: しかしお姉さまは，友人にも紹介していることもあり後には引けないということで別れたくないと，相者様にお話をされましたね
dialogue.English: However, she told you that she doesn't want to break up, partly because she has already introduced him to friends and feels she can't back out now.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 相談者様↑タイプミス失礼いたしました
dialogue.English: My apologies for the typo earlier.

dialogue.content: 相談者様はお姉さまに別れるよう説得しているけれども，お姉さまは別れられないとおっしゃっている，とこのような状況でお間違いないでしょうか
dialogue.English: You have been trying to persuade your sister to break up with him, but she says she can't. Is this an accurate summary of the situation?

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です　気づかなかったです
dialogue.English: That's fine—I didn't even notice.

dialogue.content: はい状況はその通りです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's the situation exactly.

dialogue.content: 今まで苦労してきたお姉さまを見ていると，今度こそは幸せになってほしいと思いますよね
dialogue.English: Seeing your sister struggle like this, it's natural to want her to find happiness this time around.

dialogue.content: 苦労をしているか？というのはどうかと思いますが
dialogue.English: I'm not sure if you could say she's been 'struggling'...

dialogue.content: 自由奔放に生きてきて　自分勝手にやっていた人だから
dialogue.English: She's always lived a very free-spirited, self-centered life.

dialogue.content: 今回の事はどうしてもやりきれないのか
dialogue.English: I wonder if she just can't get over this particular situation.

dialogue.content: 様子がおかしくて心配です
dialogue.English: She's not acting like herself, and I'm worried.

dialogue.content: なるほど，そうでしたか。それは本当に心配ですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so that's how it is. That must be very worrying indeed.

dialogue.content: 親も高齢で相談はできないし
dialogue.English: Our parents are elderly, so she can't talk to them.

dialogue.content: 最近は姉も鬱っぽくなっていて心配です
dialogue.English: And lately, my sister seems depressed, which worries me.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。だからこそ，兄弟である相談者様が何とかしなければとお思いなのですね
dialogue.English: I see. And that's why you, as her sibling, feel you have to do something.

dialogue.content: はい　どこに相談していいのかわからなくて
dialogue.English: Yes. I didn't know who else to turn to for advice.

dialogue.content: 相談員さんはこういう場合どう思いますか？
dialogue.English: In a situation like this, what do you think, counselor?

dialogue.content: そうですね，大切なお姉さまのことなので，一緒に考えていきましょう
dialogue.English: Of course. This is about your dear sister, so let's think about this together.

dialogue.content: 相談者様は，お姉さまがどのようになったら安心できますか？
dialogue.English: What outcome for your sister would bring you peace of mind?

dialogue.content: やはい彼の事を忘れて心落ち着いてくれたらと思います
dialogue.English: I guess I just want her to forget about him and find some peace.

dialogue.content: 例えば，別れてくれたら，とか，鬱っぽさが改善されたら，とか
dialogue.English: For example, if she broke up with him, or if her depression improved?

dialogue.content: 彼には会ったこともないのでどんな人なのかわからないから
dialogue.English: I've never met him, so I don't know what kind of person he is.

dialogue.content: とにかく自殺だけは避けたいです
dialogue.English: I just want to prevent her from committing suicide, at all costs.

dialogue.content: なるほど，そこまで落ち込んでいらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.English: I see, she is that deeply depressed, then.

dialogue.content: 先ほど，不倫する理由が分からないとおっしゃっていましたが，
dialogue.English: A moment ago, you mentioned that you don't understand the reasons for having an affair.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 相手の方のことを少しでも知ることができれば，お姉さまが別れたくないとおっしゃっている理由が分かるかもしれないと思ったのですが，いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I was thinking that if you could learn a little more about the man, you might be able to understand why your sister doesn't want to break up. What are your thoughts on that?

dialogue.content: そうですね　彼に会ってみたいいのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: That's true... Should I try to meet him?

dialogue.content: そうですね，それも1つの方法だと思います。
dialogue.English: Well, that is one possible approach.

dialogue.content: ですが，
dialogue.English: However,

dialogue.content: 相談者様はお姉さまのことをとても心配していらっしゃり，少しでも心が安定してもらえればと思っていらっしゃるので，
dialogue.English: you are very worried about your sister and want her to find some emotional stability.

dialogue.content: お姉さまとゆっくりと相手の方について聴いてみるのもいいのではないかと思います。お姉さまも今の状況をゆっくりと信頼できるあなた様に話すことで，整理ができるかもしれないと思ったのですが，いかがですか？
dialogue.English: So, I think it might also be helpful to take the time to listen to your sister talk about him. By talking about her current situation with you, someone she trusts, she might be able to sort through her own feelings. What do you think of that idea?

dialogue.content: そうですね　彼の事を詳しく聞いてみたら落ち着くかもしれないですね
dialogue.English: I see. If I listen to her talk about him in detail, she might calm down.

dialogue.content: それは気がつかなかったです
dialogue.English: I hadn't thought of that.

dialogue.content: 私が聞いても分からないと思われていると思っていました
dialogue.English: I just assumed she thought I wouldn't understand even if she told me.

dialogue.content: ええ，今はもしかしたら妻子持ちだと知ったショックで頭がいっぱいになっているかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: Yes, right now she may be overwhelmed by the shock of finding out he has a family.

dialogue.content: 多分そうだと思います
dialogue.English: I think you're probably right.

dialogue.content: それでも兄弟である相談者様にこのデリケートな問題を話すことができたということは，それだけ相談者様に心を許しているということだと思います
dialogue.English: And yet, the fact that she was able to talk to you, her sibling, about such a delicate issue shows just how much she trusts you and feels she can open up to you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました　私も少しは落ち着きました姉と私は正反対の性格だから　私が言っても意味ないと思っていました
dialogue.English: Thank you. I feel a bit calmer now, too. My sister and I have completely opposite personalities, so I thought there was no point in me saying anything.

dialogue.content: 相談者様もここに相談にいらっしゃるくらいお姉さんのことを気遣って親身になっていらっしゃるので，お姉さまのお話をしっかりと聞いて差し上げれると思いますよ。
dialogue.English: You care about your sister so much that you came here for advice, so I'm confident you can be a great listener for her.

dialogue.content: ええ，ぜひ，お姉さまとゆっくりとお話しする時間を作ってみてくださいね。
dialogue.English: Yes, please do try to set aside some time to talk with your sister slowly and calmly.

dialogue.content: そうですかね　少しは気持ちが変わってくれたらとおもいます　早速今日でも話してみます　ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: You think so? I hope her feelings might change a little. I'll try talking to her, maybe even today. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: はい，ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: You're welcome. Thank you.

dialogue.content: (時間になりましたので，ここで終了とさせていただきます。本日はありがとうございました。)
dialogue.English: (Our time is up, so we will end the session here. Thank you for coming in today.)

dialogue.content: はい　了解です　ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, understood. Thank you very much.
